integrity.proven_claim: Exact all-positive-parameter stationary energy covariance, unique monotone sign curve, and its endpoints.

scientific_limitations: Symmetric two-state Poisson self-propulsion, positive damping, linear one-dimensional harmonic confinement, no translational thermal noise.
The general stationary moment recursion appeared in prior work; the new contribution is the closed energy covariance and its full sign classification.
Publication priority and experimental identifiability are not independently established.
title: Exact energy-covariance reversal curve for an inertial run-and-tumble oscillator
